text:
anita: Quick convo: we need a concise policy for locale-heavy customers during v1->v2 catalog migration. TL;DR: prefer soft migration with limited pin windows.
jorge: Soft = route live traffic to v2 unless customer explicitly pins. Offer short self-serve pin (<=21d) and paid reviewed extension.
sara: Metrics: sample 200 core prompts + 50 edge prompts per locale. Use embedding cosine (1536-d) with thresholds: >=0.88 pass, <=0.82 fail, in-between flagged for human review. For long outputs, also track normalized ROUGE-L delta >0.10 as regression.
mike: Infra: v2 kv-layout differs; fallback to v1 is expensive. We'll provide a lightweight v1-compat shim for normal rollouts; true fallback reserved for emergencies. Canary cadence: 5% for 24h -> 20% for 48h -> 100% if stable. For big cohorts (>10k qpm) extend each step to 48h.
anita: Rollback triggers (draft): sustained 5xx >0.8% for 30m, cost per token +25% sustained 12h, or embed-sim drop >0.06 rolling 6h.
sara: Human review flow: ops surfaces flagged cases, product adjudicates with rubric (fidelity, hallucination severity, tone). Keep review turnaround <48h.
mike: Billing: add `pin_metadata` to usage events (pin_reason, expires_at, shim_enabled). Need ~2 weeks to wire billing.
jorge: UX: self-serve pin for <=21d; requests for >21d trigger review and optional paid extension. I'll draft comms + opt-out link.
ops-bot: canary-deploy: cohort eu-l10n-2 rolled to 5% at 2026-03-24T11:02:00Z.
anita: Owners: sampling matrix = sara by Wed EOD; shim + billing schema = mike by Fri EOD; comms + UX = jorge by next Tue. Speak up if thresholds look off.
sara: Fine by me.
mike: Good on infra.
jorge: LGTM.
anita: Closing and will post the one-pager in #product. Thanks.
